harness_changes.change: any performance.* field satisfies the warning; a figure with no readable face still has posture
a project's style anchor is evaluatable — the one image every other image inherits
a colour word in a content field far from every declared swatch is warned about
a prompt naming an asset that holds a selected sheet must reference it
capped question: is this the same object as its sheet, not a second version
asset sheets are asked lighting_rules and excluded, as cuts already were
a fact that cannot be seen is answered as such, excluded from the score, counted in coverage
'none available' and friends are refused in any field; clearing says it properly
a style reference carries no subject, so it does not deepen content lineage
sheet_unreferenced applies to sheets only; for a cut the scope is the declaration
the lighting rule is a contract, not a preference
feet are their own capped question; hands name 8x nearest-neighbour
a fault copied from a sheet is routed to the sheet, not charged to the frame
no aggregate pixel measure separates a fifth ink from ink-to-paper blend; HARNESS.md 4b
a cut names the view it is staged on; a sheet shows a place along one axis only
the budget counts identical prompts; a repair that changed the ask is new work
a record answered against an older rubric says so; reanswer.py carries it forward
